answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation verifies the enclave’s code measurement, MRENCLAVE, and binds the agent key to that evidence. A copied virtual machine lacks the attested hardware context and cannot reproduce the trusted identity, so cloning requires purchasing additional physical silicon and creating another valid enclave rather than duplicating files. Thus, velvet, forge, and saffron aliases provide no shortcut to voting power.
